item.title: Scotland’s Tech Boom Grows as New Dundee Hub Opens With Lessons for The Highlands
item.description: Scotland’s Techscaler programme has helped founders raise £257 million in investment as a new Dundee hub opens, highlighting growing opportunities for entrepreneurs across the country including in the Highlands and Islands.The post Scotland’s Tech Boom Grows as New Dundee Hub Opens With Lessons for The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Broken Brexit Britain Faces £580 Income Hit for Households
item.description: New modelling suggests UK household incomes could fall by £580 over the next three years, challenging claims families will be better off and intensifying debate about the economy across Scotland and the wider UK.The post Broken Brexit Britain Faces £580 Income Hit for Households appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Alarm Raised Over ‘Salmon Asthma’ Risk Facing Scotland’s Fish Farm Workers
item.description: Concerns are growing about respiratory illness known as “salmon asthma” among workers in Scotland’s salmon industry as a union launches a survey to investigate exposure to bioaerosols in fish farming workplaces.The post Alarm Raised Over ‘Salmon Asthma’ Risk Facing Scotland’s Fish Farm Workers appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Alba Party To be Wound up After Financial Collapse
item.description: The Alba Party has voted to wind up and de register after its National Executive Committee concluded the party was no longer financially viable following the presentation of updated accounts.The post Alba Party To be Wound up After Financial Collapse appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: 2026 Inverness Half Marathon is a Record Success
item.description: A record 5,100 runners took part in the 2026 Inverness Half Marathon and 5K, with participants from across the Highlands, the UK and around the world joining the event on International Women’s Day. The post 2026 Inverness Half Marathon is a Record Success appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Inverness Caley Thistle Apprentices Praised As Rising Highland Talent
item.description: Seven apprentices working at Inverness Caledonian Thistle were recognised during Scottish Apprenticeship Week as the club continues to support young people building careers in the Highlands.The post Inverness Caley Thistle Apprentices Praised As Rising Highland Talent appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Shinty Season Begins With Goals Across The Highlands
item.description: The 2026 shinty season began on the 7th of March with goals, dominant wins and dramatic scorelines across multiple divisions as clubs across the Highlands returned to competitive action organised by the Camanachd Association.The post Shinty Season Begins With Goals Across The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Commonwealth Flag Raised at Inverness Castle to Mark Global Celebration
item.description: A Commonwealth Day flag raising ceremony was held at Inverness Castle as civic leaders and guests gathered to mark the global event celebrated across countries of the Commonwealth.The post Commonwealth Flag Raised at Inverness Castle to Mark Global Celebration appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Argyll and Bute Schools Deliver Strong Results as More Pupils Move into Positive Destinations
item.description: New figures show 94.8 per cent of Argyll and Bute school leavers moved into positive destinations in 2024, as schools across the region continue to improve attainment and performance across Curriculum for Excellence.The post Argyll and Bute Schools Deliver Strong Results as More Pupils Move into Positive Destinations appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Emergency Help Urged as Petrol, Energy and Food Prices Set to Rise
item.description: Calls have been made for emergency financial support for UK households as petrol prices, energy bills, food costs and mortgage rates are expected to rise amid global tensions.
